newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: Czech CNB fixes crown +2.95 pct vs mark/dlr basket.
newsitem.headline: Czech CNB fixes crown +2.95 pct vs mark/dlr basket.

text.p: The Czech National Bank (CNB) fixed the crown at 26.941 to the dollar after Thursday's fixing at 26.965, and at 17.690 to the mark from 17.748.
The rates imply a deviation from the midpoint of the central bank's mark/dollar basket of +2.95 percent, after a deviation of +2.71 on Thursday.
As the central bank calculated today's fixing, the crown was trading on the interbank market at +2.91.
The crown fixing is announced daily at about 1140 CET (0940 GMT), and is within plus/minus 7.5 percent of the mark/dollar basket midpoint calculated at 11:30 CET.
